implemented: Finite adventure-enemy hunts in the separate Battle Royale mode.
features: Up to 24 spaced dry hunt sites with plant clearance; adventure snails, armored snails and wild bees.
Normal weapon, shell, guard, armour and dash rules; CPUs can hunt through bounded nearby perception.
Guaranteed apples or milk plus armour, weapons or upgraded backpacks; ordinary chest odds unchanged.
Finite pending/paid public loot claims, no respawns or storm rewards, separate hunt counts and adventure-save isolation.
Bounded compressed ordered deltas, one-second checkpoints, paused recovery and transient-attack cancellation.

final_focused_repairs.scope: Architecture, import, Python tooling checks and 14 selected Godot scenarios after JSON credit validation and checkpoint fixture repairs. Full suite results are retained separately.

additional_loot_tuning_rerun.scope: Upgraded backpack rewards, airborne floor landing, finite hunt credits and survivor victory isolation.

real_peers.scope: Three OS processes and real encrypted Holepunch over an isolated loopback DHT; abrupt host kill, paused recovery, new authority, plant reservation and duo settings, selected actor count and CPU difficulty, CPU replacement, consumed backpack apples, ongoing healing, opened chest/drop recovery and finite hunt death/credit recovery. Not WAN/NAT acceptance.

limitations: Player authority is trusted; this is not trustless anti-cheat or deterministic distributed physics.
Real-peer evidence uses an isolated loopback DHT; separate-device/WAN/NAT acceptance remains unmeasured.
Performance is an eight-second native offline benchmark at adaptive 1440p with invulnerable survivors, not a locked-FPS guarantee or online fanout benchmark.
Rewards, ammunition risk, encounter density and PvP interruptions need human balance playtests.
As with the existing migration design, recovery can roll back to the last agreed one-second checkpoint.
